## v1.40.0

Adds a `speech` group of doctor checks and a reply check on the probe. They find text a voice reads badly: digits and symbols on a voice made for another language, hyphenated respellings, and prompts that never say the reply is spoken. Nothing breaks. The new findings are `info` or `warn`, and `ignore` hides them.

### Added

- `mgmt.doctor` finds `spoken_text_digits_cross_language` (`warn`), `respelling_hyphen_or_mixed_case` and `spoken_output_undeclared` (both `info`). They run under the new `speech` category, so `only: ['speech']` and `skip: ['speech']` work. (#PR)
- `mgmt.doctorProbe` accepts `spoken: { rawTerms }`. The result adds `reply.spoken` with the raw terms, digit runs and symbols found in the reply. (#PR)

### Docs and skill

- `docs/DOCTOR.md` has a Speech section, a symptom row and a "Write for speech" guide. (#PR)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.39.0...v1.40.0
